notes.zh: App 免费：交易记录、分类、现金记账、日结、赊账本、统计、手机播报都不收费。音箱套餐在 App 里用 M-Pesa Pay Bill（444174，账号 05850）付款，自动开通。新用户可以用手机号直接注册。导出 Excel 改为分享到其他应用或保存到手机。
notes.en: The app is free: records, categories, cash, the day's close, the credit book, statistics and the phone's voice. Pay for the speaker plan in the app with M-Pesa Pay Bill 444174, account 05850: it starts by itself. New shops can sign up with their phone number. Excel export now shares to another app or saves on the phone.
notes.sw: Programu ni bure: rekodi, makundi, pesa taslimu, hesabu ya siku, daftari la madeni, takwimu na sauti ya simu. Lipia kifurushi cha spika kwenye programu kwa M-Pesa Pay Bill 444174, akaunti 05850: kinaanza chenyewe. Maduka mapya yanaweza kujisajili kwa nambari ya simu. Excel sasa inatumwa kwa programu nyingine au kuhifadhiwa kwenye simu.
